refused_packet.what_that_establishes: a translated Ethernet frame from the target to this station on channel 40 with the EAPOL Ethernet type, received clear and non-aggregated; NOT that it is an EAPOL-Key frame or message 1, which the decoder never reached, and no body field is known
refused_packet.which_check_refused_it: the clear-EAPOL decoder at this revision refuses any packet whose byte 7 is not 0 before it reaches the group and vector stage; every other base-header check (match, channel, header flags, WLAN index 1, TID and security 0, status 0xc000) is satisfied by the measured bytes; the optional-vector relaxation of 0151 was therefore not reached
refused_packet.vendor_source_fact: the pinned gen3 receive path never reads the RXD BSSID field (HAL_RX_STATUS_GET_BSSID is defined and unused); it routes received data by the WLAN index to the station record and its BSS; payload format 0 is its MSDU case
refused_packet.inference_not_measured: the source proves only the RXD bit layout and WLAN-index routing and gives the BSSID field no meaning; 15 is recorded as the BSSID tag observed before the station activation; that the hardware had no BSS to match (the BSS configuration command had not been submitted) is a consistent reading, not a source fact

join.management_exchange_note: false only because the lifetime ended without the deauthentication and teardown the accepted-path grammar requires; it does not mean the association was not accepted

classification: accepted association, then a refused receive with its header named: scan and open-system authentication as before, the RSN-bearing association request acknowledged and answered with status 0, then the next received packet (147 bytes, data type, group 4 only, translated, EAPOL Ethernet type, from the target, BSSID field 15) refused by the clear-EAPOL decoder's byte-7 check before the vector stage, ending the lifetime before activation; no RF beyond the scan and the two management exchanges
support_limits: the accepted association (status 0) is demonstrated at the driver for the second time; mac80211's association and the firmware station activation were not completed; one translated data packet with the EAPOL Ethernet type from the target was received and refused unidentified beyond its header: no EAPOL-Key framing observed, no data frame delivered to mac80211, no key, nothing transmitted beyond the two management frames; proposal 0152 (admit BSSID tag 15 before the BSS configuration is submitted) follows
